title: Moon and Lighthouse
description: A surreal night scene features a giant smiling crescent moon with blue eyes and swirling patterns, from which a blue robed figure floats while shooting a lightning bolt toward a striped green and white lighthouse. Below is a glowing green orb containing a red sunset over mountains, all reflected in a calm body of water with a small house on an island.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape at twilight with a giant smiling anthropomorphic moon with blue eyes in the sky, a blue robed wizard-like figure floating in front of it shooting a bright blue lightning bolt, a large glowing green orb containing a red sunset over dark mountains, a tall green and white striped lighthouse with scaffolding on rocky shore, all perfectly reflected in a calm pool of water with a small dark house on an island in the foreground, vibrant cosmic colors, whimsical and magical atmosphere
